The Rangers have won two of three games on this road trip, and this is the last game. They are 11-1-0 when they score first. At the -225 to -218 prices reported this morning, the Rangers' edge may already be priced in. This lead is only worth pursuing if lineup news favors New York. Puck drop is Fri Nov 13 at 9:10 PM EST; outlets list 9:00 PM ET.
discovery.question: Do Vancouver's goalie choice or returning players (Chytil, Willander) close the gap enough that the price is too high? Is Garand confirmed for NYR, and how does his .905 save percentage hold up as Shesterkin's fill-in?
